people.her: a young woman with long damp dark red hair, in revealing steel plate armour: round steel pauldrons, a steel breastplate cut low, bare midriff, a short plated skirt, bare thighs and steel greaves; a sword and a round shield
people.warden: the Ford-Warden, a drowned giant nearly three times a man's height, a deep hood over his head, a ranger's leather jerkin and old mail soaked dark, a long beard heavy with river water, eyes of cold blue light under the hood, in his left fist a square cage-lamp of black iron with a cold pale blue flame
people.grim: Grimtunnel, a squat long-armed goblin-like lampling with warty grey toad skin and a wide grin, a small warm orange lamp strapped to his forehead and another hanging from his belt
people.heart: the Warden's heart, a fist-sized faceted stone full of brilliant cold white-blue light, water running off it
people.ford: a dark stony river ford in the last hour of night, mist on the water, dark pines on the banks; square stone pillars with cold blue flames in iron cups; no bridge

1.prompt: medium close-up of the hooded head and shoulders of {warden} at the instant her sword's blow lands on his hood: his head snapping aside, a spray of water and sparks off the hood, the blue light in his eyes guttering; motion lines, impact; dark pines behind

2.prompt: low medium long shot at water level: {warden} gone down on one knee in the river, his greatsword falling from his right hand into the water, his left arm still holding the cage-lamp with its blue flame clear of the water; {her} small at frame right on a stone; {ford}

3.prompt: low close-up looking up at {warden} on his knees, his bearded face under the dark hood, the blue light of his eyes dim, his head lowered toward the lamp in his fist below frame, tired; the night sky behind

3b.prompt: medium close-up of {her} in cold blue lamplight, looking up at someone huge before her and nodding once, slowly, with mercy; dark pines behind

4.prompt: insert at water level: a huge mailed fist lowering a square black iron cage-lamp into black river water, the cold blue flame hissing out in a puff of steam; his knee and leg in the water beside it; stones; darkness

5.prompt: wide shot from behind {her} standing in the shallows: before her the body of a drowned giant, three times her length, lying face down across the river, still; mist closing over him; under the water at his chest a cold white-blue light beginning to glow; square stone pillars and pines beyond

6.prompt: medium shot pushing in at water level: {heart} rising slowly out of the black water by the giant's dark shoulder, alone in the air, turning, its cold light spilling over the ripples and the stones; nothing holds it

7.prompt: over the shoulder from behind a young woman with long dark red hair, her hair and shoulder in the near foreground at frame left: low over the water before her {heart} drifts toward her on its own like a thing finding its way, the giant's dark body beyond it in the river; the far bank and pines

8.prompt: extreme close-up side view in the dark: a woman's bare reaching fingertips and {heart} floating free a hand's breadth from them, nothing holding it, its cold light leaning toward her fingers like a flame in a draught; the rim of her round shield behind, out of focus

9.prompt: medium shot on a dark river ford at night: the riverbed bursting upward between {her} and the floating {heart}, a fountain of mud, gravel and water, and {grim} erupting out of it up to his waist, snatching the glowing stone out of the air with both long arms; she recoils at frame left, sword up

10.prompt: medium close-up from a woman's eye height looking down at {grim} half out of the mud, hugging the stolen glowing stone to his chest, its cold light under his chin, his little orange head lamp shining up into camera; he has gone still and dipped his head in something very near a bow; dark pines behind

11.prompt: medium shot at water level: {grim} diving head first down into a hole in the churned mud of the riverbed, only his back, legs and kicking feet still showing, the glowing white-blue stone clutched under him lighting the mud from below as he goes; a woman's armoured legs at frame left; his little orange lamps swinging

12.prompt: extreme long shot from high over the river looking west along the dark water: the ford small in the middle of the frame with one tiny figure standing in it, square stone pillars along both banks with cold blue flames all dipping at once; rings shivering across the water; pines; the lowest edge of the sky going grey; no bridge

13.prompt: high angle shot looking straight down on a shallow misty river ford in the grey before dawn: one small young woman with long dark red hair standing alone in the water among the stepping stones, sword lowered; the dark body of a giant lying face down upstream of her; one cold blue flame on a pillar at the edge; the camera pulling up and away
